title: [Chapitre] VI. Analysis situs (deuxième mouture) : notes manuscrites (18-20/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. In the 1986 'Analysis situs (deuxième mouture)' notes, Grothendieck sets up 'ateliers': sets of 'figures' equipped with
- a relation ≪ (being a sub-figure, or face);
- a support map X ↦ |X| into a set L of 'atoms';
- a relation X ≭_M Y between figures, read as 'in good position' (its strong form ∥ means disjointness);
- a boundary ∂.
He imposes axioms At 1–At 15 on these. The model case is Fig(L), the atelier of figures built from L. On pp. 89–90 he tests the axioms in the 'ensembliste' case:
- M is a family of finite subsets ('figures') of a set L of atoms.
- X ≭_M Y holds iff |X|∩|Y| = K and K ∈ Σ, where Σ is a chosen class of 'admissible' sets. This is At ens 2_Σ, the translation of At 9_Σ.

On this page.
(1) The extreme case Σ = all admissible sets (axiom At 9'). Here any two figures are in good position as soon as their supports meet in an admissible set. Grothendieck says this is equivalent to F being a 'sous-atelier spécial' of Fig(L). He immediately warns that this will hardly ever happen for the simplicial ateliers, his main intended examples.
(2) At 10 is automatic here, from At ens 2.
(3) At 13, stability under filtered colimits. Take a family F_i ≪ F, locally finite near F; then the colimit lim F_i' should stay in the atelier. The axiom is empty when the figures are of finite type, because such a family is then stationary.
(4) At 12. Its consequence from At ens 2_Σ is a 'local criterion' for good position, At ens 4, parallel to At ens t.f. 4. Let X' ≪ X and Y' ≪ Y in M, and put K = X∩Y.
- Hypothesis: for every X'' in the class X̃' with X'' ≪ K (equivalently X'' ≪ Y), and every Y'' in Ỹ' with Y'' ≪ K (equivalently Y'' ≪ X), we have X'' ≭_M Y''.
- Conclusion: X ≭_M Y.
So good position of X and Y can be tested on the pieces that lie over their common part K.
(5) Using At ens 2, the condition F ≪ X in At 13 just means |F| ⊊ |X|. At 13 is therefore always satisfied in the ensembliste setting.

Purpose. This is routine verification that the general atelier axioms hold, or reduce to simple set-theoretic conditions, in the purely combinatorial (set / abstract simplicial-complex-like) model. It belongs to Grothendieck's attempt at an axiomatic 'tame topology' of figures, as announced in the Esquisse d'un programme.
errors: No outright mathematical error is visible.

The ordering and numbering of the axioms are unstable: 'At 12' and 'At ens 4' are written over struck numbers, and the header of the colimit axiom is overwritten before being referred to as At 13. The statement of At ens 4 is a draft; the precise meaning of the classes X̃', Ỹ' depends on definitions on earlier pages.
The equivalence 'At 9' ⇔ F is a special sous-atelier of Fig(L)' is asserted without proof.

ideas.what: Atelier axioms (figures, ≪, supports, good-position relation, boundary) checked in the purely set-theoretic model where figures are finite subsets and good position means the intersection lies in a class Σ
ideas.modern_name: Axiomatic combinatorial/tame geometry; closest notions: abstract simplicial complexes, o-minimal cell structures, Grothendieck's 'topologie modérée'
ideas.usually_credited_to: Tame topology programme: Grothendieck (Esquisse, 1984); o-minimality: van den Dries, Pillay–Steinhorn, Knight (1984–86)
ideas.where_published: Only the programme for tame topology is sketched in Esquisse d'un programme (§5–6); the atelier formalism itself is unpublished as far as I know

ideas.what: Stability of figures under locally finite filtered colimits, vacuous for finite-type figures
ideas.modern_name: Locally finite unions / ind-objects in a tame category

ideas.what: Local criterion: good position of X and Y can be detected on sub-figures lying over their common part K = X∩Y
ideas.modern_name: Locality of transversality / general position, checked near the intersection

missed.claim: The atelier axiomatics of 1986 (At 1–At 15, sub-ateliers, ensembliste and simplicial models) is an unfinished, unpublished attempt at an axiomatic tame topology. This page only checks the axioms in the trivial set-theoretic model; its interest lies in the overall programme, not in a new result here.
missed.quote: Mais on se rappellera que ce ne sera guère jamais le cas pour les ateliers simpliciaux.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could be compared with o-minimal and cell-complex axiomatics, but this page contains no new theorem.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine verification of draft axioms in the simplest combinatorial model. The atelier framework as a whole is little known, but nothing specific on this page would surprise a specialist.
transcription_corrections: 'F est une sommation spéciaux de 𝔉 Fig(L)' should read 'F est un sous-atelier spécial de Fig(L)'.
'on ne sera guère jamais le cas pour les opérations simpliciaux' should read 'ce ne sera guère jamais le cas pour les ateliers simpliciaux'.
'At 10 automatiques par At en (2)' should read 'At 10 automatique par At ens (2)'.
The heading 'At [...]3 Axiome de stabilité par lim. filtrantes' is the axiom later referred to as At 13, written over struck text.
The margin note reads something like 'vu dans la discussion des "très spéciaux"', not 'vo dans le dévissage'.
The relation symbol should be the 'good position' relation written ≭ with subscript M, consistent with p. 89, rather than ≢.
'(que les la famille (F_i') sera alors = stationnaire)' should read 'car la famille (F_i') sera alors stationnaire'.
